comparison: Complete-font byte occurrences in unoptimized native CLI and lib-test executables, before and after canonical static backing. This is embedded executable storage evidence, not release-build, iOS-binary, RSS, peak-memory, or throughput evidence.
isolated_incumbent_result: Both original pointer assertions also failed when run alone with --test-threads=1 against the same compiled lib-test executable; 0 passed, 2 failed. No fixture or assertion changed.

reproduction.scope: Build the baseline commit and the candidate with the same pinned toolchain, features, and build environment. Absolute executable paths below identify the measured artifacts, not portable output locations.
reproduction.artifact_selection: Use target/debug/fmd (or the corresponding CARGO_TARGET_DIR) and the root lib-test executable printed by cargo test. The original cached-body/mono pointer tests fail in the baseline, but its built executable can still be scanned.
reproduction.counting_method: For each of the 45 asset paths listed in before.fmd.assets, read the complete TTF file and count non-overlapping exact occurrences in each executable with Python bytes.count. Verify its SHA-256 is unchanged, and sum max(copies - 1, 0) * asset_bytes. Record whole-executable file size and SHA-256 separately.
reproduction.interpretation: Compiler/linker settings and build layout can affect baseline constant-promotion counts; the recorded numbers describe these exact artifacts.

remaining_test_fixture_copies.note: These explicit test-only fixtures are outside the bundled registry and were intentionally left unchanged.

validation.baseline_cache_assertions: Both original assertions failed in isolation with --test-threads=1.

candidate_root_font_tests.includes: Five root font cache/CJK tests plus 26 existing EPUB embedded-font tests matched by fonts::tests.
